rows.name: France Talent residence permit fee restructuring
rows.description: The 2026 Finance Law restructures residence permit fees effective 1 May 2026. Base fee rises to €150; some permit categories (including certain talent/skilled worker permits) reach up to €350 depending on category. Visa fees remain separate. Talent Passport holders (now officially 'Talent' permit under post-2024 nomenclature) largely exempt from new civic exam requirement introduced 1 January 2026.

extras.new_threshold_value: €150 base fee; up to €350 for some categories

rows.name: France civic exam & language requirement for first multi-year permit
rows.description: From 1 January 2026, non-EU nationals applying for their first multi-year residence permit or 10-year resident card must pass a 40-question digital civic exam (80% pass mark) and meet stricter French language levels (A2 for initial permit, B1 for renewal, B2 for 10-year card). Talent permit holders are largely exempt. Based on the Loi immigration of 26 January 2024 and subsequent decree.

rows.description: From 8 April 2026, sponsored Skilled Workers must be paid the required minimum salary in every individual pay period (not just as an annual average). New immigration rules set out limited averaging provisions for variable-pay arrangements. Applies to CoS issued on/after 8 April 2026.

rows.description: September and October see extreme demand at Berlin, Munich and Hamburg Bürgeramt (registration) offices as new university students and autumn arrivals need Anmeldung. rows.description: National public holidays on 25 and 26 December 2027. All government offices, BAMF, Ausländerbehörde, Bürgeramt, banks and embassies closed. Christmas falls Saturday and Boxing Day Sunday — most agencies will observe substitute days. Effective closure period typically 24 Dec – 2 Jan. Avoid any government-dependent relocation activity.

rows.name: 2nd January (New Year Holiday) — Scotland only
rows.description: Scottish-only bank holiday. Scotland immigration offices, banks and most businesses closed. England, Wales and NI operate normally. Key for HR teams with employees settling in Scotland — no government services in Scotland on this date.

rows.name: Good Friday
rows.description: Bank holiday UK-wide. All UKVI, UKVCAS biometric centres, Home Office, banks closed. Part of Easter long weekend (Good Friday + Easter Monday = 4-day closure for most). No visa appointments. UKVCAS typically books out weeks ahead — pre-plan biometric appointments around Easter.

rows.name: Easter Monday
rows.description: Bank holiday in England, Wales and Northern Ireland (not Scotland). UKVI, UKVCAS, Home Office and banks closed. Combined with Good Friday creates 4-day Easter closure in England/Wales. Scotland has separate summer bank holiday instead.

rows.name: Early May Bank Holiday
rows.description: UK-wide bank holiday (first Monday in May). All UKVI, UKVCAS biometric centres, Home Office and banks closed. No immigration appointments available. UKVCAS centres are often booked 3-4 weeks in advance; avoid expecting last-minute slots around this date.

rows.name: Spring Bank Holiday
rows.description: UK-wide bank holiday (last Monday in May). All UKVI, UKVCAS, Home Office, banks closed. No immigration appointments. Post-Brexit UKVCAS centres in major cities frequently have 4-6 week lead times; plan biometric appointments well in advance especially around bank holidays.

rows.name: Scotland World Cup Bank Holiday
rows.description: Special one-off bank holiday declared by Royal Proclamation for Scotland only to mark Scotland's return to the FIFA World Cup finals. Scottish government offices, banks and many businesses closed on Monday 15 June 2026. No impact on England, Wales or Northern Ireland. For HR teams with Scottish-based employees: plan around this extra closure.

rows.name: Christmas Day
rows.description: UK-wide bank holiday. All UKVI, UKVCAS, Home Office, banks closed. Combined with Boxing Day (and substitute days when Christmas falls on weekend) creates an effective 2-4 day government closure. UK immigration system effectively shuts down late December. No biometric or visa appointments available.

rows.name: Boxing Day (substitute day)
rows.description: Bank holiday substitute day for Boxing Day (observed Monday 28 Dec as 26 Dec falls Saturday). UK-wide closure: UKVI, UKVCAS, Home Office, banks all shut. Effective government closure typically runs 25 Dec – 1 Jan. No immigration services available during this period.

rows.name: UKVCAS Biometric Appointment Peak Demand
rows.description: UKVCAS (Sopra Steria) biometric enrolment centres across the UK regularly have 3-6 week lead times for appointments, especially in London, Manchester and Birmingham. Post-Brexit visa demand means slots fill fast after each bank holiday. HR teams should book biometric appointments immediately after visa decisions, not after arrival. September-October is particularly high-demand as students and new fiscal-year transferees arrive simultaneously.

rows.description: UK-wide bank holiday. All UKVI, UKVCAS, Home Office and banks closed. Falls on Friday 1 January 2027. Scotland also observes Monday 4 January as 2nd January substitute. Government fully reopens Tuesday 5 January in Scotland, Monday 4 January in England/Wales.

rows.name: 2nd January Substitute Day 2027 — Scotland only

rows.description: UK-wide bank holiday on 26 March 2027. UKVI, UKVCAS, Home Office, banks all closed. Easter long weekend (Fri 26 Mar – Mon 29 Mar) creates a 4-day closure in England/Wales/NI. No immigration appointments available.

rows.name: Easter Monday 2027

rows.description: Christmas Day falls Saturday 25 Dec 2027; substitute bank holiday observed Monday 27 December. Boxing Day substitute Tuesday 28 December. Effective UK-wide government closure 25-28 December 2027. All UKVI, UKVCAS, Home Office and banks closed across all four nations.

rows.name: Fermeture Estivale — Peak Demand Warning
rows.description: French government offices, including Préfectures handling titre de séjour and OFII for visa validation, operate with significantly reduced capacity July-August (fermeture estivale). Préfecture appointment slots for residence permits can be booked 8-12 weeks ahead during summer. HR teams should submit applications and book OFII validation appointments by May for summer moves.

rows.name: New Year Extended Closure
rows.description: While only January 1 is an official public holiday, Japanese government offices (including Immigration Services Agency regional offices) and most businesses observe a de facto closure from approximately 28-29 December through 3-4 January. Ward offices handling My Number registration and residency notification also closed. Plan any pre-move government interactions to complete by 25 December.

rows.name: Golden Week
rows.description: Japan's major holiday cluster: Showa Day (29 Apr), Constitution Memorial Day (3 May, observed 6 May 2026), Greenery Day (4 May), Children's Day (5 May). Creates a near-continuous closure from 29 April through 6 May 2026. All ISA immigration offices, ward offices, banks and most government services shut for effectively 8 days. One of the most disruptive periods for relocating employees. Book pre-Golden Week immigration appointments well in advance; post-Golden Week backlog can be 2-4 weeks.

rows.name: Obon (Informal Closure Period)
rows.description: Obon is not an official public holiday but most Japanese companies, including many government contractors and some ward offices, operate at minimal capacity 13-16 August (most regions). ISA immigration offices remain officially open but with reduced staff. Banks and private businesses widely closed 13-16 Aug. In Tokyo/Kanto, Obon is 13-16 July. Plan around this informal but widely observed closure.

rows.name: Silver Week 2026
rows.description: Rare 'Silver Week' in September 2026: Respect for the Aged Day (Mon 21 Sep), Citizens' Holiday (Tue 22 Sep — bridge day between two holidays), Autumnal Equinox Day (Wed 23 Sep). Creates a 3-day government closure. ISA immigration offices, ward offices and banks all closed 21-23 September 2026. Silver Week does not occur every year — next occurrence after 2026 is uncertain.

rows.name: Golden Week 2027
rows.description: Golden Week 2027: Showa Day Thu 29 Apr, Constitution Memorial Day Mon 3 May, Greenery Day Tue 4 May, Children's Day Wed 5 May. Consecutive closure 29 Apr – 5 May 2027. All ISA immigration offices, ward offices, banks closed for 7 days. Pre-book all immigration appointments and alien registration activities before mid-April.

rows.name: Silver Week 2027 (Respect for the Aged / Equinox)

rows.name: Boże Narodzenie 2027 (Christmas)
rows.description: Christmas Day Saturday 25 December and St Stephen's Day Sunday 26 December 2027. Office for Foreigners, Urząd Miasta and banks closed. Employers must provide substitute days off for Saturday/Sunday public holidays. Effective government closure 25 Dec 2027 – 2 Jan 2028.
